policy: A capability is PASS only with an executed receipt; absent native capabilities are SKIPPED/BLOCKED with a reason and are never substituted by an analytical model.
description: Generic rotating thermo-fluid-mechanical assembly exercised from a mixed/conditional design space to a provenance-backed candidate set. Acceptance is defined on declared quantities and capabilities, not application-specific names.

independence.rule: element count alone never satisfies flow-solution independence; the declared QoI must converge
